QuestInfo.name: MapleStory 3rd Anniversary Bonanza
QuestInfo.0: To commemorate the 3 year anniversary of MapleStory, apparently there's going to be a huge event. I better go see #b#p9010000##k in town.
QuestInfo.1: I better find #b#t04031297##k that a lot of the monsters around the area may have.\n\n#t04031297:# #b#c4031297#/1
QuestInfo.2: I took the party invitation, clarified that I'm a traveler in the world of Maple, and received #b#t1002508##k. #b#p9010000##k can't make it to the party, and asked me instead to talk to #b#p1002100##k of Lith Harbor.

0.0: Hello! Can you believe it's been 3 years since you first visted the Maple World? To celebrate this momentous occasion, we planned a humongous bonanza for everyone. Would you like to join the fesitivities?

yes.0: In order to join the MapleStory 3rd Anniversary Bonanza, you'll have to prove that you're indeed an adventurer in the Maple World. If you're a true adventurer, then you should have #b#t04031297##k. #b#t04031297##k looks like a red envelope with a leaf drawn onto it like this #i04031297#, and it can be found by defeating monsters. If you can find #b1 #t04031297##k from a monster and give it to me, then I'll let you in the party as well.

no.0: I really wish you could come and help celebrate the 3 year anniversary with us...

1.0: Did you bring #b#t04031297##k? Okay let me see... it is indeed the #b#t04031297##k for the MapleStory 3rd Anniversary Bonanza! Since you brought the invitation card, I'll give you #b#t01002508##k so you'll stand out more at the actual party.

yes.0: Hopefully you like #b#t01002508##k. Wear #b#t01002508##k whenever you're participating in any of the events celebrating the #eMapleStory 3rd Anniversary#n. The details can be found at the MapleStory website. Also, if you have time, please go see #b#p1002100##k at Lith Harbor. She told me she was definitely going to the party, but... I haven't heard a word from her since, and that concerns me... Please go see her for me.

item.0: In order to join the party, you'll need #b#t04031297#, right? #b#t04031297##k can be found through monsters at a nearby hunting ground.
